messages:
Maria (Marketing): Heads-up: planning a small 'skill-share' refapp launch next week to surface how teams can wire Redwood into a tiny UX + benchmark story. Goal = 1 blog post + 1 short webinar + gated sample kit. Who can help with the benchmark narrative and webinar run-of-show?
Alex (DevRel): I can own the refapp repo + tutorial flow. thinking 30-min demo + 10-min Q&A for webinar.
Sam (Eng): I can capture perf numbers on Hosted vs Dedicated for the short benchmark. will run a couple of seq-length profiles and token-cost runs. low-effort config: lora+8bit and a float16 baseline.
Jen (Growth): Nice. We should tie the webinar CTA to the gated sample kit and a short checklist for infra decision points. I can draft 3 headline hooks.
Maria (Marketing): Perfect. Alex, can you sketch the tutorial steps (developer POV) in a 1-pager? Sam, can you target 3 benchmark charts: latency P50/P95, tokens/sec, and cost per 1k tokens?
Alex (DevRel): On it. rough 1-pager by EOD tomorrow. includes quickstart, endpoints, and a tiny A/B suggestion for caching vs no-caching.
Sam (Eng): Will run experiments today -> share numbers and a small script. planning to include this snippet in the benchmark appendix:

```bash
# run perf harness
python perf/run.py --model redwood-v2-small --mode streaming --seq 512 --batch 4
```

Sam (Eng): Also will log environment: GPU type, quant flags, and Redwood client version.
Jen (Growth): For messaging, propose 3 angle options: "Ship faster with predictable inference costs", "Scale UX without sacrificing latency", "On-prem-ready demo for regulated apps". Which resonates best for community?
Maria (Marketing): I like angle 1 for general devs, 2 for product folks, 3 for enterprise outreach. Let's map each angle to a landing fragment and an email drip.
Caleb (Ops): FYI — Dedicated demo pool available next Tue afternoon. If you need reserved capacity for demo runs, book it by Monday.
Alex (DevRel): Noted. I'll claim Tue 2-4pm for live demo.
Jen (Growth): I'll start a short registration page draft. Can we use the community newsletter and OSS channels for lift?
Maria (Marketing): Yes — plan: newsletter + Discord + Twitter + a DevRel demo post. Jen, can you draft copy? Alex, can you give 3 repo screenshots I can use in the post?
Alex (DevRel): Will post screenshots + a tiny GIF.
Sam (Eng): Deliverables: perf csv, run script, and 3 charts by Mon 11am.
Maria (Marketing): Webinar run-of-show proposal: 5-min intro, 10-min why inference matters, 10-min live refapp demo, 5-min benchmark walkthrough, 15-min Q&A. Thoughts?
Alex (DevRel): Sounds good. I'd swap demo & benchmark to show numbers after the demo — demo then numbers to back claims.
Jen (Growth): Agree with Alex. Also let's record and clip 90s highlight reels for social.
Caleb (Ops): Can enable recording and generate clip download post-event.
LaunchBot: Reminder scheduled: create event page 3 days before, auto-assign webinar recording task.
Maria (Marketing): Action items: Alex - 1-pager + screenshots + GIF; Sam - perf artifacts; Jen - registration + email + social copy; Caleb - reserve demo pool & record; Maria - blog + post copy. We'll sync Mon 10am for final readiness. :party-parrot:
